Miconazole, in turn, interacts with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. This indicates a chain of molecular interactions where Sivelestat may influence the activity of miconazole, which then affects the transporter. The final score of 0.5213 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Sivelestat and the transporter. The evidence highlights a possible regulatory mechanism involving the interaction of drugs with receptor and transporter systems, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
